selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB compressed in-memory swap active on node1
selected_evidence.summary: After creating zram0 via zram-generator, swapon --show and zramctl show /dev/zram0, 981M, algorithm zstd, active as [SWAP]
zram0 configured with swap-priority=100; baseline showed zero pre-existing disk swap devices (empty /proc/swaps), so zram is the only and highest-priority swap

dev-zram0.swap and systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service are systemd-generator-created static units (regenerated from /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf on every boot); post-reboot check confirms both are active without any manual step
Captured boot_id d6298ced-a924-4ce7-bbed-0fb8179eda8e, uptime, and confirmed zram swap active and services active pre-restart
Backgrounded systemctl reboot with a 2s delay so the exec call returning 'reboot scheduled, pid 8907' completed before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just service bounce)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id read as 1c856cb8-f1f8-45eb-bfc9-e215f6fc9369 (differs from baseline d6298ced...) and uptime shows 0 minutes, proving a genuine reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service/data (zram swap)
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, swapon --show and zramctl again show 981M zstd zram0 swap active with priority 100, matching pre-restart state, with dev-zram0.swap and systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service both active
